title: Historia de las plantas de Nueva España, Vol. 1
author: Francisco Hernández (1517-1587)
notes: Royal physician Francisco Hernández's 16th-century systematic survey of Mexican plants — written 1571-1577, first published 1942 by UNAM/Instituto de Biología (ed. Ochoterena). Vol. 1: documents peyote, ololiuhqui (morning glory), teonanácatl mushrooms, and other entheogens central to Mesoamerican religious practice.
